cand.title: Is building local production capacity for agricultural and construction machinery lighting and solutions at its existing Guadalajara plant; production is expected from end-2027.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: David Alfredo Interian is publicly listed as Head of Industrial & Professional Services | Indirect Purchasing - Americas at FORVIA HELLA, October 2023–present: a relevant procurement-routing contact, not a verified lodging buyer. Dr. Fabian Utermöhlen is identified in the project announcement as Vice President Sales & Marketing, Business Group Lifecycle Solutions: a project-linked commercial sponsor who may route an introduction to industrialization/local administration. Neither person is evidenced as controlling hotel contracts.
findings.futureEdition: No future event edition identified. The 5 March 2026 announcement states production will begin from the end of 2027 at the existing Guadalajara lighting plant. This operational milestone falls within November 2026–May 2028, but is not an event date; no exact start/end date or inauguration is published. Retain as a prospective corporate-project lead, not an expired March 2026 event.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: visiting industrialization engineers, equipment suppliers, trainers or customer teams could need guestrooms and small working meetings before/around the planned end-2027 production start, but no such travel is confirmed. Sheraton Guadalajara Expo offers city-hotel guestrooms, Wi-Fi, room service, catering and over 400 square meters of event space near Expo Guadalajara/Plaza del Sol. This supports a business-stay/meeting proposition rather than a resort proposition. Expo proximity is not evidence of project demand: the industrial campus may be in El Salto, outside the Expo corridor, so validate commute and transport first.
findings.venueCommitments: The project is committed to existing Guadalajara manufacturing capacity, not a hotel or Expo venue. A company-hosted certificate identifies the HAM-L El Salto lighting factory at Carretera a El Castillo Km. 10.5, San Jose del Castillo, El Salto, Jalisco. The project release does not explicitly identify that street address as the receiving production line; confirm the exact campus before assessing transport. No hotel commitment was identified.
findings.historicalRotation: Not applicable: this is production localization, not an evidenced rotating event series. No historical editions, host-hotel timeline, or annual recurrence were established for this project.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing status: UNKNOWN / UNCONFIRMED, not open and not confirmed closed. No project-specific hotel RFP, room block, incumbent hotel, travel-management company or booking channel was identified. The official purchasing page covers services and publishes supplier guidance; it does not establish an accommodation tender. The 2025 annual report says administrative indirect-purchasing activities have been carried out by FH Services S.A.S. since 1 July 2023. Ask the regional services-purchasing contact whether local travel, shared services or a travel-management company owns lodging sourcing.
findings.organizationStructure: Corporate automotive supplier, not an association, PCO or DMC. FORVIA HELLA is part of FORVIA Group; the announced off-highway expansion relates to Lifecycle Solutions and uses existing lighting manufacturing capacity. The company certificate names HELLA AUTOMOTIVE MEXICO S.A. de C.V. as the El Salto certificate holder; it does not identify the contracting entity for this project’s lodging. Administrative indirect purchasing involves FH Services S.A.S., a jointly managed HELLA/FORVIA venture.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No sourced incumbent hotel, competing room block, overflow demand or shortage was found. Inference: industrial-site access and corporate travel-policy eligibility may matter more than Expo adjacency. Marriott states the hotel does not provide shuttle service; any plant-transfer arrangement must be scoped and priced rather than assumed included. Do not present this as an Expo overflow account.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach David Alfredo Interian first to identify the Mexico travel/lodging category owner and onboarding route; approach Dr. Fabian Utermöhlen for a project-team introduction if needed. Validate campus, industrialization/training milestones, nonlocal visitor origins, stay lengths, expected room-night pattern, current hotels, booking channel, policy/rate caps and next review date. Then offer a tailored corporate-rate/guestroom-plus-small-meeting proposal with separately costed transport. Do not reserve inventory or report an RFP until a buyer confirms actual demand.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: No current event edition or publicly accessible hotel procurement process is established. This is not an expired one-time event: the published operational target remains end-2027, but actual hotel accessibility is unknown. Relationship outreach is appropriate; a claim of bookable group demand is not.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: seek inclusion in project-related corporate lodging consideration before the planned end-2027 production start, with potential follow-through into January–May 2028 only if commissioning/support travel is confirmed. This is account-development potential, not verified annual recurrence, a future event edition, or a scheduled hotel rebid.
